description: Implementation of CustomerAttributeService handling creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of CustomerAttribute entities, using CustomerAttributeDao for persistence operations within a Spring service context.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing CustomerAttribute entities, extending generic service and implementing specific business logic for customer attributes.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerAttribute, re-fetching it by ID to avoid detached instance errors.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute associated with a specific customer option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Gets all CustomerAttributes for a given customer within a store.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes for a specific option ID.
